title: View the PKGBUILD file of a package with paru
summary: Display the PKGBUILD script for a package directly in the terminal. This allows you to inspect the build instructions before installing.

steps.explain: Download and display the PKGBUILD file for the specified package in the terminal.

placeholders.name: PACKAGE
placeholders.description: The name of the package whose PKGBUILD you want to view.
